findings.finding: Returned evidence snippets contain literal U+FFFD replacement characters, but are not verbatim substrings of the fresh pypdf extraction. The pinned PDF extraction contains the encoded accent bytes while the returned snippets replace them with U+FFFD.
findings.reproduction: revalidate(pinned_pdf) succeeds; [e['snippet'] in _text(pinned_pdf) for e in result['evidence']] == [False, False]. Returned snippets contain codepoint 65533.
findings.required_fix: Generate evidence from the exact extracted text (or a deterministic, explicitly recorded normalization whose output is checked against source text); never fabricate replacement-glyph snippets. Add containment/evidence equality tests.

findings.finding: _text does not pin or validate the expected 43-page PDF, empty pages, extraction errors, or truncation. SHA/byte pinning catches ordinary byte mutation, but the parser contract itself lacks the declared page/extraction guard.
findings.required_fix: Assert exactly 43 pages and reject unreadable/empty/incomplete extraction before identity promotion; add drift/truncation tests.
